camps.description: Alabama-Florida Council's 520-acre summer camp outside Enterprise, Alabama (physically in AL). Scouts BSA summer camp with air-conditioned dining hall, lake with floating dock, canoeing on Lake Essayon, archery/shotgun/rifle ranges, and the 'Pathfinders' first-year camper program; Scouts choose 10 merit badges plus a high-adventure activity.
